QUOTE: Without `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`, so `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` becomes `ctx->private_state`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states the default rename to private_<member>, but never says that defining the macro makes MBEDTLS_PRIVATE expand to the member name unchanged. It only says the opt-out gives "real field names" or "the same access", which doesn't state the expansion.
